description: `--help` after a command path prints the generated help topic exactly.

stdout.text:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli run submit [FILE] [OPTIONS]

Run a program on the hosted service and stream it until it finishes, detaches or the deadline passes.
Inputs: --input KEY=VALUE overrides the same key from --inputs-file.
A --wait shorter than the run exits 21 with details.resumeArgv: the run continues, and that command follows it again. Never submit again to resume; that starts a second paid run.

Arguments:
  FILE                        Program file, or - for standard input. Omit when --from is given.

Options:
  --from [OWNER/]SLUG[@REV]   Run a saved program; a bare SLUG is your own program. @REV is a rev_id, or @N (@revN) for revision N of your own program; without @REV the latest revision is pinned.
  --input KEY=VALUE|KEY=@FILE
                              Program input; @FILE reads UTF-8 text of at most 1 MiB. It overrides the same key from --inputs-file. Repeatable.
  --inputs-file FILE          JSON object of string inputs; an --input of the same key wins.
  --model MODEL               Hosted model id (see `cli model list`). Default: the service's default_model (`cli model list`).
  --reasoning-effort EFFORT   Reasoning effort supported by the model. One of: minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh.
  --environment ENV           Where the run executes (for example builtin: file tools only; linux: a shell without network access). Web access is through the browser:interact tool. Default: the service's default environment.
  --runtime RUNTIME           Runtime offered by the service. Default: the service's default runtime.
  --repo OWNER/NAME[@BRANCH]  Read-only repository context. Repeatable.
  --commit-output OWNER/NAME[@BRANCH]
                              Writable repository that receives the run's commit.
  --detach                    Return as soon as the run id is known.
  --wait DURATION             Stop following after this long and exit 21 (for example 90s, 10m, 2h; maximum 6h). The run continues. Default: 30m.
  --session UUID              Use this session UUID instead of a new one (recovery only).
  --yes                       Confirm this operation; required because it starts a paid run: a hold (money set aside from the wallet, not the price) is reserved now, and the run's price is charged when it settles.
  --preview                   Print the planned request of a mutation and send nothing.
  --json                      Print one JSON result; the same as the global --output json.
  --help                      Show help for this command.

Examples:
  prose cli run submit hello.prose.md --preview
  prose cli run submit hello.prose.md --yes
  prose cli run submit --from exowner1/hello --input topic=rain --yes --detach --json

Output: openprose.service-operation/1 (--json) or openprose.service-event/1 lines (--output jsonl). The run id is result.runId (and result.run.run_id once the run ends); the answer is result.run.response.
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 invalid invocation, configuration or CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED; 10 service or credential error; 21 deadline or detached: the run id is known and the run continues (resume with details.resumeArgv); 22 run failed, or submission ambiguous (recover with details.resumeArgv: the same session with --detach, never a new run); 24 cancelled on the service.
